title: S01 Compact Two-Seat Sofa
description: Original S01 standalone two-seat living-room sofa, 1.68 m wide, 0.88 m deep and 0.92 m high. Metres, front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. Two broad seafoam seat pads and two rear-leaning back cushions have separate modeled seams. Low upholstered arms enclose the seats; an inset dark-seafoam deck and rear shell connect to a narrow honey-maple base rail and four short tapered feet. The stepped front cushion, deck, rail and feet remain legible. Named closed components are independently editable in native source and GLB. One complete independent sofa, not a sectional snap system. Static visual furniture only; no animation, upholstery simulation, ergonomic, installation, load, tip-resistance or cross-asset compatibility certification.
